title: im.vector.modular.widgets (MatrixMedia Stream Widget)
description: Widget registration state event for the MatrixMedia stream widget. Event type is 'im.vector.modular.widgets' with state key 'mm-stream-widget'. Created automatically by the @mmbot when the first '!mm live' command is issued in a room. Follows the Element widget API convention.

type.description: Widget type identifier. Always 'com.matrixmedia.stream' for MatrixMedia stream widgets.

name.description: Human-readable widget name displayed in the room widget list.

url.description: Widget URL template. Supports Matrix widget variable substitution: $matrix_room_id (current room ID) and $matrix_widget_id (this widget's ID). Must point to the MatrixMedia server's /_mm/widget/ endpoint.

mm_server.description: Base URL of the MatrixMedia server. Used by the widget to discover the API endpoint.

data.description: Arbitrary data passed to the widget. The 'mm_server' field is used for server discovery.

creatorUserId.description: Matrix user ID of the bot or user that registered this widget (typically '@mmbot:<server>').

id.description: Optional widget ID. If omitted, clients use the state_key ('mm-stream-widget').

waitForIframeLoad.description: Whether the client should wait for the widget iframe to load before displaying it.
